value:
# NR HMD colour assessment: Dragonsreach baseline attempt

The attempt is inconclusive for NR colour quality. All 36 scheduled baseline stereo pairs passed native PNG, hash, eye, camera, configuration, recording and producer checks. The three unchanged NR-off sequences failed the frozen regional stability gate, so all 66 remaining schedule steps were explicitly marked not run.

The task used the user-requested FOV 0.95, peripheral TAA disabled, DLSS at native render size (2468 × 2740 per eye), and fixed character face/skin isolation. All captures used hmd_submission with fallback rejected and sdr_srgb PNG encoding. No alignment or colour normalization was applied.

Of 360 baseline eye/region comparisons, 330 exceeded the predeclared 0.15 gradient-presence/sign mismatch limit. Median face mismatch was 0.811 (left) and 0.806 (right); armour was 0.840 and 0.837. The camera stayed within the frozen limits: maximum view-matrix element delta 0.0002952 and position-adjust delta 0.03617 engine units. Projection matrices were unchanged. Native crops show subject animation/displacement, which prevents attributing fixed-pixel colour changes to NR. The independent crop review is retained in blinded-baseline-review.json.

Camera attribution from commit e3e731a83ff72387bdeebdae5b038cf87d826656 worked: every baseline eye pair had matching current source-world matrices. Earlier FOV 0.60 scout and final FOV 0.95 scout each also had 12/12 fresh camera records. Two initial scouts are preserved as excluded: the journal was open during the first, and foveated dispatch was disabled during both. A short prerequisite probe confirmed successful stereo NR inference once dispatch was enabled; it is not comparative quality evidence.

Physical mapped CommunityShaders.dll matched the enabled AIO, adjacent manifest and package receipt: Build ID 4385d3607500f6dd1006d3c90bd9a15b89eb193ab3795b4300b9155ec37c38e9, SHA-256 ae697555b7cb4e541dbb89428da89decb41c64f7aadf389e2d6105243130dfcb, 24,922,112 bytes. The exact profile contained one enabled loose provider, with no overriding DLL in Overwrite or unmanaged Data. Separate DevBench module identity was also verified. See physical-provenance.json.

Cleanup confirmed recording inactive, zero active screenshot sequences/pending operations/outstanding jobs, NR and character rendering restored off, colour/exposure evidence capture off, and time scale restored to 20. FOV 0.95 and peripheral TAA off remain active at the user's explicit direction. The user offered to reposition the scene away from fire; a fresh plan and baseline gate are required for that view.

The direct helper's large baseline-result stdout was truncated by the shell output budget, causing a JSON parser error after the complete gate was already saved. The saved gate and three committed sequence entries were recovered without replaying measurements. Raw failure evidence remains in steps/003/failure.json. This did not change the failed stability outcome.

No colour winner, retained-neural-detail result, candidate stereo verdict, NVIDIA domain conclusion, exposure-recovery qualification, physical display verdict or frame-rate flicker claim is supported by this attempt. Full canonical regional, temporal, stereo and exposure diagnostics are in analysis/private.

camera_or_global_geometry_change.note: No obvious large change in static wall/shadow landmarks. Native crops alone cannot exclude small camera drift or establish full-scene camera stability.

character_animation_or_subject_movement.note: Changing face/armour geometry against apparently stable background is consistent with character movement. The images alone do not establish the precise animation mechanism.

crop_occupancy_and_boundary_truncation.note: Facial landmarks and armour/highlight features cross fixed crop boundaries. These samples do not consistently contain the same physical surfaces at the same pixel locations.

illumination_or_exposure_change.note: No obvious large common brightness step in the static crops. Subject appearance and highlight changes are inseparable from changing pose/material coverage; subtle global or local illumination changes are not excluded.

exclusions: Exclude face, armour and stud_highlights regions from unqualified fixed-pixel colour/detail comparison across these sampled reference repeats in either eye.
Do not treat the similar s1 f01/f12 endpoints as proof of within-sequence stationarity; f06 shows a clear excursion.
Do not infer algorithmic temporal instability from the visible subject motion.
Do not rank repeated unchanged references as colour modes or treat apparent background stability as a whole-image tie.

observations.finding: The prominent near-vertical mortar joint, horizontal joint and rough stone texture remain in visibly similar positions. The warm overall tone shows no obvious large discontinuity in this sparse visual review.

Dark stone seams and the faintly warmer lower-left region retain similar placement and appearance, with no obvious moving occluder or large shadow boundary change. Low luminance and crop size limit subtle shadow judgments.

Studs, chains and leather enter or leave the small crop. A bright background wedge enters its upper-left area in displaced poses. Highlight differences therefore cannot isolate colour processing, exposure or retained detail.

The face is relatively centred at f01 and f12, but at f06 it shifts toward the right crop edge, exposing substantially more doorway at the left and cutting off part of the right side of the face. Similar endpoints conceal the intermediate motion.
The f12 face is displaced to the right relative to f01/f06; eye, nose and mouth positions and the amount of background differ.
The face shifts upward and left across these samples. By f12 upper facial content is cut by the top crop edge and more lower face/neck area occupies the crop.
Stud positions, leather folds and chainmail boundaries move. The s1 f06 armour layout differs clearly from both endpoints; s2 late and s3 samples also replace surface content at fixed pixels.
Stone edges and mortar landmarks retain similar positions and tone within the right eye. No obvious large background displacement or brightness step appears in the reviewed samples.
The dark masonry pattern and warmer lower-left patch appear stable, without obvious crop occlusion. The different wall coverage relative to the left eye is not by itself evidence of a stereo defect.
The amount and location of chainmail, shiny studs, leather and bright background change with pose. Bright-point comparisons would compare different surface occupancy.
At f06 the face moves toward the right boundary and exposes more doorway at left; f01 and f12 return to similar framing. This independently confirms intermediate motion in the right-eye samples.
At f12 the face is farther right than at f01/f06, with changed landmark locations and crop coverage.
Facial content moves upward and left, and the upper face is increasingly cut by the crop. This prevents correspondence at fixed pixel coordinates.
The rivet/stud pattern, leather folds and chainmail edge move within the crop. The right eye shows the same broad subject-pose changes as the left, assessed against its own samples.

limitations_and_untested_conditions: Only supplied native fixed crops were reviewed; original full-eye images were not supplied to this review.
All 90 supplied crops were inspected, but they cover only f01, f06 and f12 of each set, so this remains a sparse subset of any original sequence.
No timing metadata or capture cadence was supplied.
No candidate images, mappings, technical measurements, camera metadata or exposure diagnostics were consulted.
Visual review did not perform numeric pixel comparisons, hash checks, alignment, normalization, resizing or white balancing.
Small crops and deep shadows limit subtle colour, clipping, banding, noise and temporal judgments.
No conclusion covers uncropped scene regions, uncaptured poses, additional scenes or conditions, native HMD frame-rate flicker, or physical display/lens behaviour.

sys.path.insert(0,str(checkout/"tools/nr-color"))
import hmd_assess as h, hmd_capture as c
def payload(name): return json.loads(h.read_json(root/(name+".json"))["content"][0]["text"])

scene=payload("fixedSceneCurrent")
acq=manifest["children"][0]["actual"]["acquisition"]
fingerprint="dragonsreach-20260916T1029-fov095-character-mask"
region_defs=[

policy={"schemaVersion":1,"sceneFingerprint":fingerprint,"motionGradientMismatchLimit":0.15,"eyes":{}}
for i,eye in enumerate(h.EYES):
 policy["eyes"][eye]={"nativeSize":[2468,2740],"regions":[{"id":r[0],"class":r[1],"description":r[2],"rect":r[3+i]} for r in region_defs],"unavailable":{}}

candidates=[{"condition":kind,"settings":{"settings":{"appearanceMix":0.0,"detailStrength":1.0,"maximumDetailStops":1.0}}} for kind in ("nr_off","raw","managed_identity","preserve_source")]

plan=h.make_plan(spec,policy,19417);c.validate_plan(plan);c.validate_fixed_scene(plan["fixedScene"])
for name,obj in (("regions",policy),("spec",spec),("private-plan",plan)):h.save_json(root/(name+".json"),obj)
host_path=Path("D:/Skyrim Mods/mods/Devbench/SKSE/Plugins/devbench.dll")
host=h.preserve(host_path,root/"provenance/devbench.dll")
receipt={"state":payload("state"),"mappedModules":h.read_json(root/"mappedModules.json"),"physicalModulePathVerified":True}
h.save_json(root/"provenance/host-identity.json",receipt)
rp=root/"provenance/host-identity.json"
host.update(buildIdentity={"version":payload("state")["version"],"sourceCommit":"7f60c2bf787d5da9efdec9b5a18ecb9a68035b4b"},runtimeMatched=True,observedVersion=payload("state")["version"],observedPid=28724,physicalModulePathVerified=True,identityReceipt={"path":str(rp),"bytes":rp.stat().st_size,"sha256":h.digest(rp)})
index={"schema":"csx-nr-hmd-capture-v1","planPath":str(root/"private-plan.json"),"planSha256":h.digest(root/"private-plan.json"),"sceneFingerprint":fingerprint,"fixedSettings":fixed,"producer":manifest["producer"],"devbench":host,"sessionId":manifest["sessionId"],"sequences":[],"performanceCampaign":False,"complete":False,"userSessionAuthorization":h.read_json(root/"user-session-authorization.json"),"untestedConditions":plan["untestedConditions"]}
h.save_json(root/"campaign-index.json",index)
settings={}
for key,candidate in plan["candidateMapping"].items():
 settings[key]=c.candidate_colour(c.colour_editable(original["color"]),candidate)
h.save_json(root/"candidate-configurations.json",settings)
h.preserve(Path("D:/Skyrim Mods/mods/Synthesis Patch (SFW)/SKSE/Plugins/devbench/recordings/recording_1789554540051.json"),root/"scout/recording.json")
print(json.dumps({"planPath":str(root/"private-plan.json"),"planSha256":index["planSha256"],"schedule":plan["schedule"],"candidateConfigurations":settings,"plan":plan}))
